# The macOS CI test projects and the stream each runs in (read by test-concurrent.sh; #8169).
# Format: <stream> <project directory> [timeout-minutes] [extra dotnet test args...]
#
# Streams run at the same time; projects inside one stream run one after another. Every project here
# disables xUnit test parallelization, so each uses about one core, and the macos-15 runner has 3
# vCPUs: three streams. Balance them by the per-project times in the job log ("finished in N s");
# the slowest stream sets the wall time. There is no slnf check: Build AllLibraries builds them all.
# These projects already run concurrently on Windows (windows-test-groups.txt), and each stream gets
# its own temp folder.

macos-1 MonoGameGum.Tests 20

macos-2 Tests/Gum.Presentation.Tests 15
